notes.title: Must Go Faster update, now with native Oculus Touch support!
notes.content:
For Oculus players the game will now automatically use the Touch controllers if they are connected.  This is native support so it includes haptic feedback.  Make sure you have your sensors set up for 360 or room-scale, this is not a front-facing game.

And for everyone the scene at the end of the midnight level has been . . . enhanced.  No spoilers!

notes.title: First day hotfix
notes.content:
For those who reported problems selecting anything in the menu, an update has just gone out that should resolve the problem. Please report any other bugs you find and I'll do my best to fix them ASAP. 

Other tweaks: clearer night sky, improved raptor animations, and the Dawn level should be a little less frustrating.
